verification_report.summary: The bounded selected-sequence addition is correct under the expressly accepted checkpoint inputs. Uniform integrability of the one chosen weighted-density sequence converts the bounded measurable truncation upper-semicontinuity statement into attainment for its weak current limits, without assuming upper semicontinuity of unbounded D_p or p in D_omega^0. The entropy argument correctly establishes both the first-moment condition and selected-sequence uniform integrability: its Gibbs calculation is justified for bounded truncations, the entropy negative part is controlled, normalization is preserved, and Portmanteau transfers the moment bound to R^{-1}p k_T dV. The proof makes none of the excluded regularity, exact-equation, whole-family, smaller-envelope, or D_omega=D_omega^0 claims. All cited items are accepted internal checkpoint dependencies or standard facts; no external-paper citation appears.
